title: Smarter app integrations and scalable DGX Spark foundations
summary: CloudlessOS 0.2.3 makes optional applications feel native, expands DGX Spark cluster foundations beyond two nodes, and adds hardware-aware compatibility and diagnostics throughout the platform.
changes: Scale the DGX Spark cluster model from a fixed pair to managed topologies of up to eight Sparks, with clearer node health and support diagnostics.
Introduce the Cloudless application manifest v2 so apps, capabilities, hardware requirements, secrets, and promotion rules share one validated source of truth.
Evaluate model and application compatibility against detected architecture, GPU, unified memory, storage, and cluster capacity before installation or launch.
Present optional applications by their real product names, descriptions, categories, services, and storage requirements in a more consistent App Launcher.
Embed n8n inside the CloudlessOS experience and automatically connect Perplexica to the active Cloudless model when the research applications are installed.
Allow installed optional applications to be pinned while preventing unavailable, stopped, or failed applications from appearing as usable shortcuts.
Add platform doctor checks, support bundles, and safer managed-secret handling for easier troubleshooting and recovery.
Harden the unified AMD64 and ARM64 release pipeline with isolated simulations, signed platform matrices, private reusable credentials, and safer atomic publication retries.
